title: createLocalIssueOnMain CREATE deixa arquivo novo como delecao-staged na worktree em main (gap do CAM-137 syncWorktreeIfOnMain pro caso CREATE)
description:
BUG vivido 2026-06-29 no fluxo /cam-spec CAM-132. createLocalIssueOnMain (CAM-86) na rota de CREATE deixa o arquivo de issue NOVO como delecao-staged na worktree quando o writer roda EM main. O sync de worktree do CAM-137 (syncWorktreeIfOnMain) cobre o caso MODIFY (o specify de CAM-132, um arquivo existente, sincronizou limpo) mas NAO o CREATE de arquivo novo.

REPRO: rodei createLocalIssueOnMain a partir do source (bun) com a worktree EM main pra filar CAM-139. CHILD_RESULT ok (committed e pushed, sha e45c39c), mas git status logo depois mostrava 'D scripts/cam/issues/CAM-0139.json' (delecao staged): HEAD tinha o arquivo, index/worktree nao. Corrigido a mao com: git restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree -- scripts/cam/issues/CAM-0139.json.

CAUSA PROVAVEL: o path do arquivo recem-criado nao entra na lista 'paths' passada ao syncWorktreeIfOnMain, OU o git restore --staged --worktree --source=HEAD nao materializa um path que esta ausente da worktree do jeito que o caminho de CREATE exige. Investigar em src/git/on-main.ts (syncWorktreeIfOnMain) + o call-site de createLocalIssueOnMain em src/commands/issue-file.ts: confirmar que o path criado e propagado.

FIX: garantir que syncWorktreeIfOnMain receba o path do arquivo criado na rota CREATE, pra um arquivo on-main novo ser materializado na worktree (mesmo invariante que o CAM-137 fixou pro MODIFY: 'deixa a worktree coerente com o HEAD apos a call'). Adicionar regressao real-git que reproduz o CREATE-on-main e assere git status limpo (arquivo presente) apos a call.

ESCOPO: so a rota CREATE em main. MODIFY (specify/abandon/merge/journal) ja coberto pelo CAM-137. Off-main ja e ref-only (CAM-133), nao afetado.

acceptanceCriteria: On the CREATE route, createLocalIssueOnMain leaves the worktree coherent with HEAD: after the call git status is clean and the newly-created issue file is present in the worktree (not deletion-staged).
syncWorktreeIfOnMain receives the created file's path on the CREATE route (the path is propagated from the createLocalIssueOnMain call-site in src/commands/issue-file.ts).

syncWorktreeIfOnMain materializes a path that is absent from the worktree (not only staged-restoring a path already present), so the CREATE case is covered regardless of which of the two candidate causes is the true root.
A real-git regression test reproduces CREATE-on-main (worktree on main, create a new issue file) and asserts clean git status with the file present after the call.
Scope stays limited to the CREATE route on main; the MODIFY route (CAM-137) and off-main ref-only writes (CAM-133) are unchanged.
bun run check:all passes and bun test is green.
spec.scope: IN: src/git/on-main.ts syncWorktreeIfOnMain (materialize an absent path for the CREATE case); src/commands/issue-file.ts createLocalIssueOnMain CREATE call-site (propagate the created file's path into the sync paths); a real-git regression reproducing CREATE-on-main. OUT: the MODIFY route (already covered by CAM-137); off-main ref-only writes (CAM-133); any non-CREATE on-main writer (specify/abandon/merge/journal).
gotchas: Repro (2026-06-29, /cam-spec CAM-132 flow): CHILD_RESULT reported committed+pushed OK (sha e45c39c, HEAD has the file), but git status right after showed 'D scripts/cam/issues/CAM-0139.json' (deletion-staged): HEAD had the file, index/worktree did not. Manual recovery: git restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree -- <file>.
CAM-137 (syncWorktreeIfOnMain) fixed the MODIFY case (an existing file synced clean); the gap is specifically the new-file CREATE case, which this issue closes.

Two candidate causes: (a) the created path is not in the 'paths' list passed to syncWorktreeIfOnMain; (b) git restore --staged --worktree --source=HEAD does not materialize a path that is absent from the worktree. Fixing at the invariant level (propagate the path AND make sync materialize absent paths) covers both without first having to prove which is the true cause.
Invariant to hold: 'the worktree is coherent with HEAD after the call' -- the same invariant CAM-137 established for MODIFY, now extended to CREATE.
